root_cause: Focus trap returns focus to the modal element when Shift+Tab leaves the modal, preventing wrap to the last focusable button.
repair_strategy: Add keydown listeners to the first (#confirm-close) and last (#confirm-delete) focusable elements inside the modal to wrap focus within the modal, and remove them on hide.
expected_accessibility_effect: Shift+Tab from the first control (close button) now moves focus to the Delete button, allowing reverse navigation within the modal while keeping focus trapped.
functional_risks: If other modals use the same element IDs, listeners could affect unintended modals.
If the modal markup changes and the IDs are missing, the listeners will not be attached, leaving original behavior unchanged.
Improper cleanup could cause duplicate listeners if hide is called multiple times without show.
verification_requirements: After opening the modal, pressing Shift+Tab when the close button is focused should move focus to the Delete button.
After opening the modal, pressing Tab when the Delete button is focused should move focus to the close button.
Focus should remain trapped inside the modal; pressing Tab/Shift+Tab repeatedly should cycle only among the modal's focusable elements.
Modal opening, closing, and the delete action (setting status to 'Deleted') should continue to work as before.
